display_long_description:
Become the frontline hero in Medic Simulator: Combat Zone — where every second counts and every decision can save a life. React to unpredictable threats and engage enemies when necessary.

Dominate the battlefield with precision and courage:
• Stabilize patients using real combat triage principles
• Control hemorrhages before they become fatal
• Apply tourniquets to stop severe bleeding
• Perform rapid procedures at a forward aid station under intense pressure
• Remove abdominal projectiles and other foreign objects from wounded arms and limbs on the battlefield
• Administer aerosol medications such as antibiotics, anti-inflammatories, and antiseptics
• Apply bandages to wounds and burns
• Transport patients safely to the infirmary

Go beyond basic first aid and operate as a true combat medic:
• Rescue wounded soldiers under enemy fire
• Work alongside nurses and search for the wounded using ambulances
• React to unpredictable battlefield events
• Engage enemies and be ready to reload your weapon
• Take on dynamic missions while searching for the injured across the combat zone

The battlefield is unforgiving — but the adrenaline is unmatched.
Are you ready to answer the call?
